title: Astrid and the Confession
author: Ulyana Eastwick
blurb: August Galloway, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
